import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill NaN in 'Sleep Disorder' with 'None' for clarity in visualization
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create a more descriptive 'Sleep Disorder' label for the legend
df['Sleep Disorder Status'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].replace({
    'None': 'No Disorder',
    'Sleep Apnea': 'Sleep Apnea',
    'Insomnia': 'Insomnia'
})

# Define a logical order for BMI Category for faceting
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Create a faceted scatter plot (relplot) to explore relationships
g = sns.relplot(
    data=df,
    x="Physical Activity Level",
    y="Sleep Duration",
    hue="Sleep Disorder Status",
    size="Stress Level",
    col="BMI Category",
    kind="scatter",
    sizes=(30, 250),
    alpha=0.75,
    height=6,
    aspect=0.8,
    palette={'No Disorder': '#3498db', 'Insomnia': '#e74c3c', 'Sleep Apnea': '#f1c40f'},
    legend="full"
)

# --- Customization and Labeling ---
# Set a comprehensive title for the entire figure
g.fig.suptitle(
    'Sleep Duration vs. Physical Activity by Health Profile',
    fontsize=20,
    fontweight='bold',
    y=1.05
)

# Improve axis labels
g.set_axis_labels("Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)", "Sleep Duration (hours)", fontsize=12)

# Adjust subplot titles
g.set_titles("BMI: {col_name}", fontsize=14)

# Adjust layout to prevent title overlap
g.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Customize the legend
plt.setp(g._legend.get_title(), fontsize=12)
for text in g._legend.get_texts():
    text.set_fontsize(11)

# --- Save the Figure ---
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
